value.rationale: Published work explicitly identifies C8 x K3 as a natural exceptional finite cycle-product test. Its Betti numbers alone do not constrain the natural D8 x S3 modules. The distinct degree-four sign and degree-five standard-plus-sign modules and the quotient comparison provide a substantive symmetry classification with direct topological consequences; finite scope is intentional and does not claim a general torsion theorem.
